questions.q: How many years does the book say the first life season lasts?
questions.why: The wealthy gardener notes the first season lasts for about thirty years.

questions.q: What is the key habit for building wealth, per Soforic?
questions.why: He stresses living below your means as the crucial step.

questions.q: How does the book define being rich?
a: Having more money than needed after expenses
questions.why: Rich is defined as having a high net margin on life, more money than you need.

questions.q: What does the gardener say we get in life?
questions.why: He states we get the poorest conditions we will tolerate.

questions.q: What does Soforic call the period needed to achieve big dreams?
questions.why: He mentions most dreams take a "five‑year crusade" to achieve.
